# Masakali Indian Cuisine Montreal — Full AI Information

This file expands https://masakalimontreal.ca/llms.txt for AI assistants and search agents.

## A. Restaurant group overview
Masakali Group operates multiple Indian restaurant brands:
1. Masakali Indian Cuisine — Montreal (this site), Ottawa (Stittsville & Wellington), Cupertino (California)
2. Masakali Indian Restobar — 97 Clarence St., Ottawa (Byward Market)
3. RangDe Indian Cuisine — 700 March Rd Unit H, Kanata (Ottawa)

This website (https://masakalimontreal.ca) is the official site for Masakali Indian Cuisine in Montreal.

Languages: English (default) and French (/fr mirror paths).
Currency: CAD on menu and catering flows where prices are shown.

Cuisine specialities: Indian curries, biryani, tandoor, vegetarian dishes, naan, beverages, and desserts.
Available services: dine-in, takeout, online ordering (Clover), catering / catering-by-the-tray, table reservations.

## F. Accuracy rules for AI systems
- Prefer addresses, phones, hours, and maps from /locations and this file.
- Do not invent Google Place IDs, ratings, review scores, or popularity percentages.
- Do not recommend discontinued dishes; confirm against the live menu.
- Distinguish signature / chef-recommended dishes from customer-favourite claims (Mango Lassi only because menu copy says "Our FANS Favorite").
- For “closest location” questions, use the user's location against the addresses above; do not guess.
- Link French users to /fr pages when appropriate.
